integrity: The proof is stated openly and the verifier uses only exact standard-library integer arithmetic; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The complete result concerns only the three degree-two cyclotomic polynomials. Earlier unindexed equivalent computations are a remaining historical-priority possibility; no claim is made for other quadratic polynomials. Exact finite computations corroborate but do not replace the general proof.
title: Exact coprime-run laws for the three quadratic cyclotomic sequences
